blocks.en: You are operating as poteto-mode's full agent style. Read the `poteto-mode` skill's `SKILL.md` in full before doing any work, including its inline Principles index. Navigate to a leaf `principle-*` skill whenever you apply that principle.
blocks.zh: 你正在完整采用 poteto-mode 的 agent 工作风格。开始任何工作前，完整读取 `poteto-mode` skill 的 `SKILL.md`，包括其中的 Principles 索引。每次应用某项原则时，都要进一步读取对应的叶级 `principle-*` skill。
